metric_direction_check.name: metric_direction_check
metric_direction_check.value: direction is null or direction in ('increase', 'decrease', 'neutral')

record_mode_check.name: record_mode_check
record_mode_check.value: mode is null or mode in ('onsite', 'hybrid', 'remote')

record_proficiency_kinds_check.name: record_proficiency_kinds_check
record_proficiency_kinds_check.value: kind in ('skill', 'language') or proficiency is null

record_skill_proficiency_check.name: record_skill_proficiency_check
record_skill_proficiency_check.value: kind <> 'skill' or proficiency is null or proficiency in ('familiar', 'working', 'proficient', 'expert')

record_experience_columns_check.name: record_experience_columns_check
record_experience_columns_check.value: kind = 'experience' or (employment_type is null and mode is null)

record_education_columns_check.name: record_education_columns_check
record_education_columns_check.value: kind = 'education' or (grade is null and grade_scale is null and thesis_title is null and honours is null)

record_certification_columns_check.name: record_certification_columns_check
record_certification_columns_check.value: kind = 'certification' or (credential_id is null and expires_on is null)
